caption: The shipped 'Logic Gate Across Two Chiplets' example (issue #1455): chiplet A carries the NOT gate and an edge coupler, chiplet B the AND gate and an edge coupler, facets abutted across the chiplet boundary — the cross-chiplet link carries the NOT output to the AND's A input.

The Logic tab (en) of 'Logic Gate Across Two Chiplets' after Build: named toggles A=0 and B=1, the cross-chiplet intermediate NOT_A = 1 and the final output Y = 1 — the truth table of NOT(A) AND B evaluated across the link.
